propositions: force_close_reason parameter is declared in transition_core but never read, causing the operator-supplied --force=<reason> value to be silently discarded
force_close_reason should be written into the close STATUS event as a present-only field mirroring close_class, in the same locked write that creates the close
force_close_reason must be folded into reduced state and declared in ticket_state.schema.json so it is readable by later readers without holding a lock
close events without --force must omit the reason key entirely to remain byte-identical to pre-change shape for backward compatibility
the current audit-comment fallback is unreliable under contention (second lock acquisition times out), making durable event recording necessary for force-close reason preservation
